The mood conveyed in the text is one of nostalgic warmth and carefree joy, set against a backdrop of intense summer heat. The atmosphere is thick and sensory, evoking a sense of timeless simplicity through the combination of heavy humidity, natural scents, and the distant laughter of children. This atmosphere contributes to the narrative by establishing a serene, almost idyllic setting that contrasts with the physical discomfort of the heat, highlighting a moment of peaceful reflection or childhood innocence.

The meal that comes second in the day, after breakfast, is lunch.
